title: [DO NOT MERGE] poc: migrate from sha256 to sha512 digests
body:
<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->
Today containers/storage uses the image's content digest as its ID. That works only because the ID happens to be a sha-256 value: pull the same image twice and it lands under the same ID, so it's deduplicated for free.

The moment IDs move to sha-512, that trick stops working, because the ID can no longer be parsed as a sha-256 digest. 

So the PoC separates the two things that were accidentally fused: identity (the ID) and content (what makes two images "the same").
